title: I built this app for my dad. Now it makes $18K/month
description:
Kourosh built an app in a very crowded market... and yet still managed to grow it to over $18K/month.  His secret is insanely simple: everyone else is chasing tech-savvy power users, but Kourosh built this app for a type of custer everyone is ignoring (his dad). This video is the story of how to build a successful product in a "saturated" market.
